milestone: Post-E EB0 roadmap reconciliation and canonical baseline

authority_boundary.included: Committed repository roadmap, Evidence Platform, data-reference, and operational-semantics artifacts at engineering HEAD dd9d6be376ee08fbbd471b88ecd8b0f14bdce0c6.
authority_boundary.excluded: All untracked EB0 scripts and audit outputs; they are working-tree context only and are not canonical evidence for this roadmap.

ratified_sequence.stage: EB0.1 canonical birth and valuation baseline
ratified_sequence.purpose: Establish immutable event-time birth identity, first-observation valuation semantics, source precedence, completeness states, and reproducible frozen fixtures before historical scoring.
ratified_sequence.dependency_reason: Committed data references state that durable first-observed market-cap coverage is recent and historically thin. Later observations must not be relabeled as birth valuation.

ratified_sequence.purpose: Compute coverage-aware creator outcomes over canonical mint membership and qualified valuation windows, separating missing evidence from poor outcomes.
ratified_sequence.dependency_reason: Creator rankings require stable birth/valuation denominators and explicit missingness; otherwise older or sparsely observed creators are systematically misclassified.

ratified_sequence.purpose: Ingest bounded external OHLCV/market observations as versioned, non-authoritative supplements joined by platform-owned mint identity.
ratified_sequence.dependency_reason: External observations can enrich outcome windows but cannot define creator identity, chain birth, migration, or canonical birth market cap. Provider access, rate/cost, resolution, and earliest-observation semantics require separate qualification.

ratified_sequence.purpose: Discover recurring role/edge/mechanism/temporal patterns across operations using canonical outcome context, while keeping topology attached to roles and treating behavioural similarity as nomination evidence only.
ratified_sequence.dependency_reason: Committed operational audits show topology is relationship metadata, role must be primary, and shared behavioural fingerprints cannot independently prove common real-world operator identity.

cross_stage_rules: Platform migration and creator identity remain authoritative; provider data is supplemental and versioned.
No observation is converted into a negative fact without an explicit completeness state.
Historical outcome scores expose numerator, denominator, coverage, observation window, and source quality.
Shared behaviour may create PROPOSED or SUPPORTED family candidates, never CONFIRMED operator identity without human review.
Every stage is local/default-off until separately qualified; no roadmap artifact authorizes production activation.

first_safe_local_implementation.objective: Define and fixture-qualify a pure local contract that projects existing committed/local fixture evidence into immutable birth and valuation observations without reading production state.
required_semantics: CHAIN_BIRTH, PLATFORM_FIRST_SEEN, MIGRATION, and MARKET_FIRST_OBSERVED are distinct event kinds.
MARKET_FIRST_OBSERVED is never called BIRTH_MARKET_CAP unless event-time and valuation semantics prove equivalence.
Missing valuation is UNKNOWN/NOT_OBSERVED, never zero, dead, rug, or poor outcome.
Conflicting provider observations remain separate versioned facts and are not silently merged.
Projection identity is deterministic and input-order independent.
qualification: Frozen local fixtures for exact birth, delayed first observation, missing valuation, conflicting sources, and replay ordering.
Schema/contract tests proving deterministic identity, explicit missingness, and no authority promotion.
One narrow engineering commit containing only the contract, fixtures, tests, and documentation.
prohibited: Evidence Mirror or Cohort Mode activation

next_gate: Explicit human authorization for EB0.1A local implementation and fixture qualification.
